requirement: Add a price-snapshot store that records opening and closing numbers for every market we originate
evidence: signals/data/price_snapshots.csv — one row per market per snapshot (open, close).

requirement: Add a verified results feed so backtests and ROI can be computed at all
evidence: signals/data/results.csv — 163 games, 137 verified finals, every row linked to the official week page.

requirement: Originate the side first, then the total, then the moneyline
evidence: Fixed pipeline order with the origination order recorded per market row; the moneyline is derived from the side plus the margin sigma.

requirement: Publish the model's fair line, the market line, and the difference as separate columns
evidence: Three separate columns per market. Market and difference are empty and flagged F-01.

requirement: Separate 'signal' from 'staking' in the leaderboard so a lucky staking run cannot mask a bad signal
evidence: Two blocks per strategy; ranking uses signal only; enforced by scripts/verify_signals.py.

requirement: Track the depth of the replacement, not just the fact of a replacement
evidence: depth_string and replacement_depth (2nd/3rd/4th) are published per absence, with a per-club-week load roll-up.

requirement: Compute correlations only from officially sourced numbers and publish n with each value
evidence: Every coefficient on signals/correlations.html carries r, n, a 95% CI, a p-value and its source link.

requirement: Define a demotion gate that sends a live strategy back to paper
evidence: Seven demotion rules (D1-D7) with measured values and the action each one triggers.
